rules.rule: Record each memory at the RE whose goal it serves, never at a PE that provides for it.

prompts.instructions: Use the Metaform map as the index into this project's memory. Functional nodes and joins are entry points to the knowledge that is relevant there. Read applicable unread memories at the functionality you work on. Follow directed relations when connected knowledge is relevant. Read relevant updates announced while you work. The same memory associated with several entry points retains one identity; separate memories remain separate even when their wording is similar. Maintain memory as uniquely named entities with types, atomic string observations and explicit directed relations in active voice. Keep each observation to one fact about its entity. Represent relationships as relations rather than leaving them only in prose. Refine existing relevant knowledge as your work establishes better understanding. Correct inaccurate observations and relations, add missing relevant relations, consolidate duplicates, and remove outdated entities, observations and relations. Add new entities and observations when the knowledge is new. Use canonical operations. create_entities skips existing names; use add_observations to extend them. Refine an observation by removing the old observation and adding its replacement, and refine a relation by deleting it and creating the corrected relation. Associate memories with the functional entry points where they are relevant, following the receiving-element and join semantics. Memory entities and relations represent the knowledge; the map supplies its index locations. An entity's name need not be a map address. During discovery, link meaningful implementation entry points as functional references. Keep execution progress and return details in work records; preserve maintained project knowledge in memory. A memory is durable knowledge of the functionality: what holds across sessions, a decision and its reason, a cause found, a constraint learned. What is going on at the moment, progress, status, who is doing what, is never a memory; it belongs in the ticket. Agents keep memory current, nobody else does: remove a memory that only records a moment when you find one, and refine or delete any memory that no longer holds unless the person has locked it.
prompts.instructions_unassigned: When work is assigned, use its functional locations as entry points to the applicable unread memories.
